inputs.text: A ceasefire is worthwhile only if it protects ordinary families and restores order—not if it turns into a lecture about “power imbalance” while leaving Israel unable to defend its people. A country cannot be expected to ignore threats in the name of an abstract fairness, and Iran should not be allowed to treat accountability as optional. Any lasting agreement must restrain the forces driving the conflict and make clear that security and sovereignty matter on both sides.
